resources.string: Shows the Room Audio options in room settings. This setting is local to this device.
Silences incoming push-to-talk audio and tones. Turn off to hear others again.
Set up a Bluetooth push-to-talk button

Allow nearby-device access to use your PTT button. On older Android versions, location permission is required for Bluetooth scanning. Then turn on Bluetooth and wake your button. It connects automatically while a PTT room is active.

Bluetooth permissions are allowed. Turn on Bluetooth and wake your PTT button. It connects automatically while a PTT room is active; the first press may only wake the button. You can manage Bluetooth in system settings.
Wake your Pryme button, then select it in Android’s device chooser. Bluetooth and Location services must be on.
Reconnect to this button while PTT is active. After Disconnect, choose Connect to resume.
Press and release your button to test it. This button will not send audio while this screen is open. Events received: %1$d
Disconnect and remove this app’s saved button. The phone’s Bluetooth pairing will remain.
Disconnected. Choose Find PTT button or reconnect your saved button.
Choose your button in Android’s device chooser.
Connecting… Press and release your button to wake it.
Nearby devices permission is required. Try again or allow it in app permissions.
Bluetooth is off. Turn it on in settings, then try again.
This phone or button does not support this PTT setup. Currently tested with Pryme BT-PTT-Z-HD.
Could not connect. Keep the button nearby, press and release to wake it, then try again.
